title: Mitosis architecture audit and rebuild exploration

completion_criteria.text: Foundational audit of the current engine complete across all four domains: two-layer fan-out, durability/resume, cost/latency, pipeline rigidity + fragility
External research verdict delivered on whether the architecture is correct, with disconfirming pass and cited prior art
The child_process runtime-capability question settled empirically (does dynamic import of node:child_process EXECUTE inside a Workflow script, not merely resolve)

Three open architecture decisions resolved by the user: adopt an off-the-shelf durable-execution runtime vs only its state model; default speculation depth given that rework costs tokens not machine time; which work-type pipelines to define first
An approved architecture spec for the rebuild exists, superseding or explicitly scoping the six paused repair-oriented mitosis threads

spine.active_goal: M0 is DELIVERED and merged (PR #21, merge commit 60f4217) - the first mitosis engine spec MSP ever implemented; PRs #1-#20 were all Track B gate/invariant hardening or docs. The hermeticity blocker that gated it is refuted and closed by 0150. Work is now straight engine implementation of the approved quiescent-advance spec, with no blocker outstanding: M1 next, then M2 -> M6 -> M3 -> M5 -> M4 -> M7 -> M8. 0086 fixes the cap at 8; 0087 fixes class-6 at file level. Track A stays deferred per 0136.
spine.next_step: Re-derive origin/main FIRST (it is 60f4217; local main is one behind); delete the merged M0 branch. Then implement M1, honest terminal states plus the blockedByApproval prune (spec section 6), as one MSP and one PR. No gate remains: 0085's caveat is discharged. Per 0151, grep M1's symbols against the twin list at mirror-guard.test.mjs:19 BEFORE editing, and re-derive every anchor by execution - the spec is pinned to 450804e, not main. Every PR owes a 12-id coverage entry.
open_risks: Spec anchors pin to 450804e, an unmerged head; against main they run +36 to +78 off VARYING BY REGION, and main has moved again to 60f4217. Re-derive by execution; never copy a spec line number (0148). Held again this session for every M0 anchor.

Spec section 10's mirror-twin gotcha list is INCOMPLETE: it names only M3/M4/M7, but M0's own symbol was a policed twin (0151). Per MSP, grep the target symbol against the 21-entry twin list at mirror-guard.test.mjs:19; the guard asserts whole-file containment.

Section 8's mechanism arithmetic (22 to 14, net -8) is still NOT re-verified - a hand-written enumeration in a baseline-pinned spec, the class 0137/0144/0145/0151 burned on. Re-derive before it gates an MSP.

NEVER invoke the compiled workflow. compileWorkflow returns a frozen async callable that would dispatch REAL AGENTS; compileUnderSandbox discards it deliberately. No test may call it. M0's test asserts the state the relaunch guard READS, not the guard.

Every PR needs a docs/invariants/coverage/*.json entry verdicting ALL 12 registry ids and ADDED OR MODIFIED in that PR's own diff; an untouched existing entry fails. Run scripts/invariant-coverage-check.mjs --event pull_request --base-ref main before pushing.
The coverage gate checks row SHAPE, never the truth of a check string, so the entry stays orchestrator-authored per 0143.

ALWAYS_DENIED's 54-entry pinned realm surface runs in CI on every push and PR while node-version floats at 26.x, so a Node minor adding a global halts the gate. Fail-closed by design (0140); classify the name, do NOT pin Node.
phase-parity requires any --target to be a compilable workflow body after ^export stripping or it exits 44; a fixture carrying ESM imports would exit 44 unanalyzed.

.gitignore:18's `*session*` swallows real files: .claude/hooks/tests/session-config-drift-check.test.mjs is untracked, so its 9 tests exist only in the primary tree and are invisible to clean checkouts and CI. Spec-loss class; belongs to the boundary-residuals thread.
Any worktree-vs-primary suite comparison must diff test-name SETS, never counts alone - a matching count could hide an offsetting pair (0150).
Every write under .claude/{hooks,rules,lib,workflows} needs per-write human approval; the engine MSPs all edit those trees. Batch edits per file; no unattended fan-out.
The pre-commit hook runs the FULL suite inline (1762 tests at 60f4217, ~187KB in one result). ALWAYS redirect and read only the tail. --no-verify only for a deliberately-red receipt commit.
A PR's scope is FROZEN at creation; post-creation title/body edits are denied. Later facts go in a PR comment (0142). Push once BEFORE opening the PR (0141). Merge stays human-gated.

Verdict truthfulness stays a HUMAN/orchestrator gate (0143). Held again: the orchestrator re-ran the full suite, mirror guard, red-on-parent revert and coverage gate itself rather than relaying the implementer's numbers.

Track A deferral keeps the 0132 hand-patch window OPEN (deployed cache carries a guard absent from its recorded SHA 0fe1c02; a refresh reverts it), and Track A round 3 was never reviewed - installer.mjs 426 to 135 into four modules. A-1 is a hard gate when Track A resumes.
Six other paused mitosis threads still need per-thread disposition. Each predates 60f4217 and must be re-grounded first - an earlier session found PR #14 already merged and main 5 behind.
12 leaked worktrees / ~78MB remain live; the reaper verb does not exist. The scratch worktree made for this session's gate was removed after use, so the count is unchanged.
PARKED stash@{0} and stash@{1} untouched, depth 2. The tree carries pre-existing dirt (.claude/settings.json, .zshrc, three untracked paths) - stage explicit paths only, NEVER git add -A.

Ledger MCP: it drops the parameter after a long multi-line value; spine fields cap at 500 chars and open_risks at 20 items of 300 chars. A Bash hook blocks reads of the store, so completion_criteria are invisible outside the MCP tools and were left untouched here.
task_70509bf0 could NOT be withdrawn - the user must stop it. Its premise is dead.
out_of_scope: Track A / continuity-ledger-plugin until all mitosis MSPs are delivered (0136). A-1, A-2, A-3 and the Track A half of Wave 0 are DEFERRED, not abandoned.
Any further B-6 work. Implemented, merged and green; the invariant is discharged. Re-opening needs a new reason, not a re-read.
Rewriting the specs' 78 anchors as a standalone effort - rejected by 0148. Re-baseline by execution per MSP instead.
Executing run-readiness-repair's MSP-0..MSP-10. Quiescent-advance M0..M8 lands first, and the overlap (M0/M1 against MSP-6/MSP-7) must be reconciled before that spec is scheduled.
Pipelines for refactor, perf, docs or chore - closed by 0118. Limits PIPELINES only, not the PR title type vocabulary.
The feat pipeline - 0110 sequences it second, after the fix pipeline proves the effector boundary.
Speculation depth above 1 - 0109 requires a restack proven for the fix work type first.
Bootstrapping a target repo's test infrastructure as a side effect of shipping - closed by 0117; that is verify-setup, human-invoked.
Adopting an off-the-shelf durable-execution runtime - closed by 0108. A webhook, server or daemon for the relaunch trigger - closed by 0119.
fileScope-only task-edge derivation - rejected by 0116, settled by 0120.
Cluster-aware scheduling and the journal's 2000-char model-output paging - fenced out by spec section 1.
Dispatching or restarting any target-repo mitosis run.
Opening a pull request for docs/mitosis-core-rebuild-spec - the user ruled on 2026-07-30 that leaving it without a PR is fine.
The 12 leaked worktrees, the Step 0 reaper, and the two parked stashes.
